tei:div.tei:p: -srog gi yi ge bri bar bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: dang po yi ge zhes bya ba: gzhi med rang gdangs mtshon pa ste: rgyu med ngo bo yi ger shar: de yi gzugs mthong rang sgra sgrog: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa nas: 'jigs tshogs dmyal ba yan chad kyi: srog snying yi ge'i rnam par shar: ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo nas: srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog bcud: kha dog lngar gsal yi ge shar: rang byung yi ge rgyud gcig 'di'o: ྈ ri rab kha khyer tha ma na: padma'i 'od zer brgyad kyi nang: yon tan kun 'dus yi ge ni: sum cu rtsa re 'od du 'khyil: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ri rab bang rim gsum pa la: srid gsum nor sdud yi ge ni: bcu drug rang 'od 'bar zhing 'khyil: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ

āom̐ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya kā ya bāktsitta siddhi hūm̐: ri rab bang rim bar ma la: rgyal po srog gi yi ge dgu: rang sar mdangs ldan 'od du 'khyil: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ bhe shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: bang rim dang po gnod sbyin gyi: srog gi yi ge bcu dgu 'phro: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ind+ra ni mu khaṃ bhra ma ri swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ dzaṃ luṃ swā hā: ri rab rmang gi tha ma la: 'dod pa tshim byed yi ge ni: lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'od zer 'phro: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ badzra yakṣa kā la dza lend+ra ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ pū dza ba liṃ ta khā hi: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ badzra yakṣa nir gha sha ra 'da' na: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bā su dhā ri dung dung: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'dus swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mi sems dkrugs ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ dkrugs khug: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya dza dza: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mi snying sgul sgul: gser gyi ri bdun 'od 'du'i nang: nor bu dbang gi yi ge ni: lnga bcu rtsa gsum mdangs dang ldan: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ yakṣa dzam bha la dza lend+ra ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma hā yakṣa: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ se nā pa ta ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sarba siddhi dha naṃ nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi pha la ā yu ṣe: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ swasti dza ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥbhyo bhyo: rol pa'i mtsho bdun 'od zer la: srog mang yi ge brgyad cu gnyis: srog gi yi ge'i ngo bo shar: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ dzam bha la dza lend+ra ya ma hā yakṣa: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma hā kā la a pa rā tsitta: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mā ra ya duntiṃ: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ratna 'ubs 'ubs: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ shaṃ kaḥr nga'i snod khongs khongs: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma hā ra ti ti ye tsi li: ྈྈྈྈ rbad ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ u tsus mas gzhan las chod chod: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ

bho to bha shig: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ khye thod thub thub: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ khye stong stong: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sha ma bha rdza gye gye: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ yakṣa nag po sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥbhyo bhyo: gling bzhi gling phran mi la sogs: bsod nams ldan pa thams cad kyi: srog dang longs spyod snying po ni: yi ge brgya dang bdun du gnas: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ tsand+ra kāent+ye ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ pūrṇa bha dra ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ dā tā ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ dha na dā ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ su dā tā ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ārya ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ke li mā li nā swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ su bha dra ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ pi tsu kuṇḍa lī nā swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ gupta ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ mu khend+rā ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ dhe bhi ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ tsaryend+rā ya swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ swa ra swa ti ye swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ratna siddhi hūm̐: de ltar khams gsum ma lus pa'i: snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dang: bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi: tshe bkrag srog dbugs dbang po'i mdangs: bsod nams mnga' thang longs spyod kyi: rnam shes snying po yi ger shar: gnad kyi yi ge 'dus pa de: phyag na rdo rjes 'di lnga gzigs: thugs ka'i ratna zur brgyad nas: sprul pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag bkye: 'od zer dbus nas dbang byed kyi: yi ge nyis brgya bzhi bcu bzhi: bung bas me tog len pa ltar: khams gsum kun dkrugs srog yig blang: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ a mu khe ma mus dha ra: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ swasti mu ma hā kṣe ma ne ma ne:

ྈྈྈྈྈ 'du ra ne: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ akṣe makṣe ma ra kye ma ra ke pa nasti: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ghur yan sarba si sti: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bruṃ 'bruṃ bruṃ si sti si sti ya spa: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ mu le mu le: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ kye she kye she: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ tsurna tsurna bhi ma le swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ kang ka ra: ྈྈྈྈྈ kang ka ra: ྈྈྈྈྈ nir gha na: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ tsa nir ga na tsa na siddhi siddhi pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ratna pun rne sid 'di sid 'di hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ hi la si a yaṃ: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sid 'di siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥdza: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ nā nā kha te sid 'di sid 'di hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dha la sam bho sid 'di sid 'di hūm̐: ྈྈྈ dza dza: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āoṃ tsakra ratna siddhi pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ma ṇi ratna sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ma hā ta ratna sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ bhast+ri rata na sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ hasti rata na sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ tu raṃ ka a shwa rata na sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ghā ta rata na sid ti pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'di ru ba sa ke ta bha ha bhe ke ni ra hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bha lin na ta na ka le ni: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bha si mu tam kaṃ bha ti hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ āom̐ ga sid 'di pha la hūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bhi tsa ya bhi tsa ya u ha si sta dza sa ni: de ltar 'gugs byed yi ges ni: srid gsum bcud bsdus dbang sgyur thob: bcud kyi snying po thugs kar thim: srog gi snying po bsdus pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud las nor bu sngags
